new_learnings.text: Strong breadth does not override sector rotation inside the book: when yesterday's holdings are in today's cold sectors, the right move is to rotate out even if individual PnL is positive.
new_learnings.mechanism: A broad rally can hide sharp internal rotation; capital leaving a previously hot industry often suppresses follow-through in yesterday's winners.

new_learnings.text: No-chasing MA filters remain critical on strong tape: several attractive names today failed only because they were too far above MA5/MA10, which is exactly where momentum traders donate open profits back.
new_learnings.mechanism: In euphoric breadth, extension risk rises because many stocks gap away from support; buying support beats buying emotional expansion.

new_learnings.text: Low-IV backdrop is not a reason to stop buying, but it does favor cleaner base-and-breakout entries over vertical spikes.
new_learnings.mechanism: When implied volatility is low, upside can still trend, but mean-reversion risk after overextended entries becomes more painful because option markets are not pricing large rescue moves.
